Overview

Verona is a city in Veneto with a population of 257,000. The city of Romeo and Juliet, with a stunning Roman amphitheater, charming medieval streets, and the picturesque Adige River. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low. The population skews older, with a median age of 47.0.
